sentences.text:
This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER T h is is applicant's first application under Section 438 of Criminal Procedure Code, 1973 for grant of anticipatory bail, as he is apprehending his arrest in connection with Crime No.97/2023 registered at Police Station Maksi, District Shajapur (MP) for offence punishable under Section 420, 466, 467,
468 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
sentences._hearing_file: Ramchandra vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: Allegations against the applicant is of preparing Patta in favour of the complainant Bahadur Singh who has lodged the report stating that the applicant gave him a Patta from a back date and when the complainant tried to take home loan on the same, it came to light that the Patta was forged and when this was informed to the present applicant by the complainant, the applicant again gave him another Patta dated 27/07/2022 which was also forged.
sentences._hearing_file: Ramchandra vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: It is also alleged that the applicant had obtained Rs.14,000/- towards bribe to give the complainant Patta.
sentences._hearing_file: Ramchandra vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023.json

sentences.text:
1 Counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant is the Secretary of Gram Panchayat,
Titodi, Janpad Panchayat Tarana, District Ujjain and has been falsely implicated in the case and has not signed any Patta and his arrest would seriously prejudice his career as Secretary of Gram Panchayat.
sentences._hearing_file: Ramchandra vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: Hence, it is submitted that the application be allowed and he be released on anticipatory bail.
sentences._hearing_file: Ramchandra vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: Counsel for the respondent / State, on the other hand, has opposed the prayer and it is submitted that looking to the allegations reveled against the applicant and the material available on record, no case for anticipatory bail is made out and the custodial interrogation of the applicant would be necessary.
sentences._hearing_file: Ramchandra vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: O n due consideration of the rival submissions and perusal of the case diary, considering the fact that the applicant has prepared two Pattas which were found to be forged and as per the information provided by the Tehsildar, it is also mentioned that the Patta cannot be given by any Panchayat Secretary or Sarpanch except with the permission of the State Government, however, in the present case, there are no such permission given to the Secretary or Sarpanch and the complainant has alleged that he had given Rs.14,000/- to the applicant, this Court is of the opinion that there was no reason for the complainant to falsely implicate the applicant.
sentences._hearing_file: Ramchandra vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: In such facts and circumstances of the case, the custodial interrogation of the applicant appears necessary.
sentences._hearing_file: Ramchandra vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: Accordingly, the M.Cr.C. is dismissed.
sentences._hearing_file: Ramchandra vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023.json
